title: Leading his own early band
summary: Asked whether he led his own band, Picou says yes; it was covered on an earlier tape.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Did you ever lead your own band, Pete? Huh? Did you ever have a band of your own? Did you ever lead your own band?
Oh, yes. I see. What did you get over there with Kevin?
Still had a little bit. They didn't have a band. What did you talk? It's great.

You had a band real early. I think you told us on the other time that we talked to you two years ago that you had your own band. I forget the name of it now. You had a special name for it too. But that's all on the tape, I think, before. I'm wondering, is there anything else about the clarinet you were going to ask Ralph?
